scope: Frozen pre-activation R3 build, fake-device checks and stationary sensor-only evidence. Subsequent supervised motor testing is a separate run and is not covered by this report.
status: Candidate passed the preserved software checks and completed a bounded stationary sensor-only probe. This evidence does not establish motor readiness or a lasting cure for IMU bias.
incident_context: After uncommanded heading change and a Sit/paw tip, a motionless supported robot produced about -109.84 degrees of measured yaw drift in 20 seconds. Source and packet analysis found transport and stale-cache defects; reset/time/calibration effects remain confounded.

preservation.verification: Every copied regular file SHA256 and size, and every symlink target, matched the remote inventory. Every indexed archive member was independently read back and checked.
preservation.retained_history: Initial/R1, R2 and R3 source snapshots, build logs, exit records and fake test logs are preserved. The initial root-source archive is the first candidate, not the original deployed driver. Original incident/probe artifacts remain separate and unchanged.

identities.environment_verification: PASS for file hashes and ament resolution only; no hardware initialization or loaded-library proof.
identities.unchanged_control_scope: Existing policy, gains, limits, report selection and calibration settings retained. No Game Rotation Vector substitution or numerical bias offset.

implemented_fixes: Bounded complete-packet reassembly validates lengths, channel, sequence and continuation; zero repeated headers wait for payload instead of consuming padding. Failed, incomplete and unsupported report batches do not update sensor state.
All complete known reports are parsed atomically. Duplicate or backward sensor sequences do not refresh component receipt clocks; valid sequence wrap is supported.
Quaternion and gyro have separate validity, accuracy and monotonic host-receipt fields. Unavailable acceleration is initialized deterministically and explicitly marked unavailable.
Exhausted invalid manager sampling revokes both cached usability flags under the existing mutex while retaining diagnostic values/timestamps; later valid sampling restores the cache.

Driver initialization and reads reject stale/invalid components. Motor activation requires a continuous sampled stationary window before enable; homing and enable transactions recheck freshness before SPI commands.

local_offline.instrumentation: Mac AddressSanitizer/UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer; Linux/ROS/tf2 compilation stubs where needed; no device access.

native_final_r3.scope: Isolated Linux build and selected fake-device tests. No production overlay replacement or motor action in these checks.

checks.counting_limit: The 41 local checks overlap the 54 native checks; they are not 95 independent tests.

readiness_screen.scope: A sampled pre-enable screen, not calibration or future-bias certification. A >100 ms observation gap resets the window. Accuracy status alone does not establish health.

stationary_sensor_only.interpretation: The screen passed once, then reset twice on small gyro-norm spikes and recovered after fresh quiet windows. This is not a continuous 30-second screen pass. The diagnostic kept evaluating the startup screen; production uses it before enable.

transport_replay.scope: All recorded read requests/bytes replayed through the exact candidate C++ helper under sanitizers. All 20,265 rows consumed; 26 zero repeated headers handled without adopting padding.
transport_replay.initial_rejections: The one timeout and one orphan rejection were constructor advertisement reads 0 through 11; no subsequent transport or report rejection.

limits: No motor trial or physical policy acceptance is included here. Subsequent supervised evidence must identify the actually loaded library and be reported separately.

A recent host receipt can contain a delayed sensor report. These clocks establish host availability, not physical measurement age; the legacy measurement_timestamp remains explicitly unverified rather than silently reinterpreted.
The 25 ms parser retry budget cannot bound a blocked kernel read. All raw reads and observed durations are retained.
The selected Rotation Vector still reports accuracy 0. No external attitude ground truth was available, and good startup readings do not rule out future bias.

Later original-driver reset probes also showed low drift. This comparison does not isolate parser changes as the cause of bias recovery; resets, elapsed time, temperature and inherited calibration remain confounded.

No explicit calibration save, erase, tare or calibration enable/disable command was issued. Vendor documentation notes a soft reset may itself persist RAM calibration data; no no-flash-side-effect guarantee is made.

The readiness window observes sampled latest component states and may not examine every intermediate report in a batch. Its quaternion bound is departure from the anchor, not every pairwise orientation difference.
next_acceptance: Use the separate root-owned supervised run for exact loaded-library, homing, floor baseline and skill observations; retain failures as well as passes.
Repeat quiet stationary checks after warmup and motion. Stop if bias, freshness failures or unintended motion recurs; do not mask them with policy gains or offsets.
Resolve physical sensor timing/calibration interpretation before presenting logged age or accuracy as ground truth. Resume broader policy acceptance only from a repeatable baseline.
